objective: Continuously reduce product workflow cost while preserving output quality and downstream utility.
recordingRules: Record stage metrics for every workflow run using stable workflow, run and stage identifiers.
Record whether downstream output was actually consumed, not merely generated.
Separate measured values from estimates and replay-derived values.
Never include secrets, credentials, personal contacts or raw private user content in GitHub artifacts.
Aggregate runtime records before committing them to the GitHub efficiency ledger.
Every workflow change must add or update optimization opportunities and document the quality guardrail.
